svg.title: Pundoku — P4 foreground layer for Icon Composer
svg.desc: Production layer. Flat, opaque, full white, transparent background, no platform mask, no baked effects (app-icons.md › Visual effects). One group: nine cells. Ground gradient and the light/dark/tinted fills are defined in Icon Composer (materials in design/pd155-icons.mjs). Generated by design/pd155-icons.mjs.
